title: Set name for placeholder materials during gltf import
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

During mesh import material names are used as `import_id`. This is necessary to e.g. properly detect for which surfaces a material override has been set.

However, for gltf files that had their materials stripped during export (something I like to do for shared materials like trim sheets to ensure the engine reuses the same rendering pipeline for them) the placeholder material generated by `GLTFDocument::_parse_meshes` has no name set. While the advanced import dialogue can still display unnamed materials there are currently two problems:

A) it is not easily discernible for the user which material belongs to which mesh

B) ResourceImporterScene exits early when no "import_id" is set, since it is required to index into `p_material_data`. Anything configured in the advanced import settings for stripped materials (like material overrides) is thus silently ignored.

This PR addresses both these problems by setting a name for placeholder materials during gltf import.

### Tool Usage
All 58 characters in this PR were designed and hand-typed by me 😅
